questions.question: Evaluate the achievements of Rajendra I as an imperial ruler. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Achievements of Rajendra I:- overran the Pandyas and Cholas – conquest of Sri
  • Lanka – conquest of the Sri Vijaya empire in Malay peninsula, Sumatra, Java and the
  • neighbouring islands - march across Kalinga to Bengal by crossing the river Ganga –
  • Gangaikondachola - Gangaikondacholapuram – improvement of trade.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Examine the Central Asian background that led to the coming of Turkish rule in India. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Turkish rule in India:- Turkish conquest – Mahmud Ghazni – Ghazanvid Empire –
  • plunder – Muhammad Ghori – Ghurid Empire – Battles of Tarain – establishment of
  • the Delhi Sultanate.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Elaborate on the measures that Balban took to curtail the power of the nobles. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Balban:- Turkish nobles Chahalgani (forty) - suppressed their power - “sijada”
  • (prostration) and “paibos” (kissing the feet of the Sultan) - introduced the Persian
  • festival Nauroz – claimed Sultan was God’s shadow on earth – claimed descendant of
  • an Iranian legendary ruler, Afrasiab – reorganised the army.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe the role of Firoz Shah Tughlaq in the development of irrigation and agriculture. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Firoz Shah Tughlaq:- taccavi loans (agricultural loans) - survey of crop production -
  • dug wells - irrigation canals; Yamuna canal.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Assess the role of Alauddin Khilji in the consolidation of the Delhi Sultanate. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Alauddin Khilji:- controlled the nobility - reorganised the army – market regulation –
  • resisted Mongol invasions – conquests over the Rajput states - conquest of the Deccan
  • and the far South.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Examine the importance of trade in the period of the Delhi Sultanate. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:

  • Red Sea regions – coastal trade – inter-regional trade – Traders; Marwaris, Gujaratis,
  • Bohra merchants, Mulatanis, Khurasanis – dalals – transport and communication –
  • urbanization – cities; Delhi, Daulatabad, Lahore, etc.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Discuss the causes of the decline of the Mughal Empire. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:

questions.question: Discuss the origin and rise of the Rajput polities in North India during the early medieval period. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Origin and rise of the Rajput polities:- early medieval period – regional kingdoms –
  • claimed kshatriya lineage – claimed agnikula origin – warrior clans – Rajastan,
  • Gujarat, central India, parts of Indo-Gangetic regions - Chauhans, Paramaras,
  • Solankis, Gahadavalas, and Rathores.

questions.question: Evaluate the impact of the Bhakti and Sufi movements on Medieval Indian society. / [CO4, CO5]
questions.solution_html:
• Impact of the Bhakti and Sufi movements:- Bhakti in south India; Alwars and
  • Nayanars – in north India; Namadeva, Ramananda, Kabir, Nanak, Nath Pandhi, etc. –
  • Sufism - Wahdat-ul-wujud - Silsilahs - Chishti and Suhrawardi - message of love and
  • personal devotion to God – denounced the caste system - emphasised the unity of God
  • - equality and brotherhood -
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Write an essay on the Mansabdari system under the Mughals. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Mansabdari System:- Akbar – nobility and army – Mansab (rank) and Mansabdars –
  • zat and sawar – dagh and chehra – highest paid service – strengthen the army
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Evaluate the process of commercial capitalism in India under colonial powers. / [CO2] [10x2 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Commercial capitalism in India:- sixteenth to the nineteenth centuries – colonial
  • powers – mercantilism - arrival of European maritime powers - the Portuguese, the
  • Dutch, the French and the English – East India Companies – transition from trade to
  • political control - the Battle of Plassey (1757) and the Battle of Buxar (1764) -
  • colonial commercial capitalis - economic exploitation – integration to global
  • capitalism – India became supplier of raw materials for British industries- market for
  • British goods – drain of wealth.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
